question: Who among the following was awarded the Olympic Order by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in July 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhinav Bindra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Abhinav Bindra**, India's **first individual Olympic gold medalist**, was awarded the **prestigious Olympic Order by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in July 2024**.
 
• The Olympic Order is the highest honor granted by the IOC, recognizing individuals for their exceptional contributions to the Olympic Movement and sports.
 
• Bindra won the gold medal in the **10m Air Rifle event at the 2008 Beijing Olympics**, marking a historic achievement for India.
 
• He has been actively promoting sports development and athletes' welfare through initiatives like the Abhinav Bindra Foundation.
 
• The award celebrates his enduring impact on Indian sports and his contributions to Olympic values and excellence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olympic Order:**

 
 
• The Olympic Order is awarded to individuals who demonstrate outstanding merit in the development of sport and uphold the Olympic ideals.
 
• It is symbolized by a chain and badge, with the five Olympic rings representing global unity through sports.
 
 
 
• **Abhinav Bindra’s Contributions:**
 
 
• Bindra has contributed significantly to sports science and athlete preparation in India through his foundation.
 
• His autobiography, "A Shot at History," details his journey to Olympic glory and inspires young athletes worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Indian Sports Achievements:**
 
 
• India has consistently improved its Olympic performance, with notable contributions from athletes like Neeraj Chopra and PV Sindhu.
 
• Bindra's 2008 gold medal paved the way for greater focus on individual sports in the country.
 
 
 
• **IOC and Its Role:**
 
 
• The International Olympic Committee oversees the organization of the Olympic Games and promotes global sports development.
 
• The IOC recognizes individuals and organizations that align with its vision of promoting peace and unity through sports.
